ungraded_rows.output_swing: the ratified grading rule is a contiguous-run reduction over a swept waveform (largest run around mid-supply with local slope in [0.8, 1.2]); no `klt sim` measurement form expresses it (klayout-tools#5518), so the row is measured (dc_swing waveform, -dc-swing.csv) but graded by no envelope
ungraded_rows.input_referred_noise: ratified as a target; issue #54's noise bench and its klt sim envelope exist, but carry no limits/spec_row and DR-003 left the graded quantity undecided (issue #274)
ungraded_rows.psrr: [TBD] in spec/target-spec.md, not ratified: no bound to grade
ungraded_rows.input_referred_offset: statistical row (T1 item 6, a Monte Carlo campaign, not a corner envelope); target proposed by DR-009, not ratified
ungraded_rows.cmrr: target proposed by DR-008, not ratified: no ratified bound to grade

rule.input_cm: buffer edge inside the fixed-CM edge by > tolerance
rule.inconsistent: fixed-CM edge inside the buffer edge by > tolerance
rule.conclusive: fixed Vcm inside the same point's 40 dB ICMR window and not inconsistent

tran_sr_icmr_summary.note: diagnostic metric only; no target closure or topology adoption is implied
